Team Leadership & Organization Design.canonical_label: Detailed narrative of org growth from 10 to 38, reporting lines and $12-15M peak spend
aliases: On people and resources, the organization grew from 10 to 38 between 2020 and 2024 - a blended mix of senior managers, architects, employees, matrixed and virtual teams, contractors and MSPs - with eight direct reports. I've always preferred to lead through empowered managers rather than a wide span, which leaves me the time for the part of the job that actually moves things: sitting with function heads and the executive committee, arguing priorities, and translating what a platform change means in business terms. I reported to the COO and later to the global CFO, and presented quarterly to the parent executive committee on technology, compliance and data privacy. My largest single-year technology spend was roughly $12-15 million? in 2020, combining the run budget with the SAP and Veeva launch programs and MSP contracts - honestly stated, that sits at the edge of your $15 million threshold rather than comfortably above it.
